page.content:
CEO and player of Grog, Fjord, and Chetney.

How Travis Willingham connects

  • Character: Grog Strongjaw — Travis Willingham plays Grog Strongjaw.
  • Character: Fjord — Travis Willingham plays Fjord.
  • Faction: Critical Role Productions — Travis Willingham is CEO of Critical Role Productions.

What is Travis Willingham?

Travis Willingham is the company's CEO and the player of Grog Strongjaw, Fjord Stone, and later Chetney Pock O'Pea at the Critical Role table.

Key threads lead to Grog Strongjaw, Fjord and Critical Role Productions.
